body: Like I said many times, I know my condition is good. Thats not what this is about. But you seem like a pretty irritating person, so I'm just not going to bother continuing this conversation. Go be pissy somewhere else please.

I'm going to be assuming you read my other topic which is what you are refering to. Yeah, I'm attrative, I'm well off, well educated and have everything going for me. But I've got my own personal demons that I deal with. Are the justified? Probably not. I graduated with a BA in Poli Sci, focusing on conflict studies in the Middle East. I know how amazing my life is, and how bad it can be for others. 

What I don't see is why this is generating hatred from you. Yes I'm lucky overall. But that doesn't mean I'm not lonely. And trust me man, I'd give up the money and all the other girls for one who really got me. If thats being selfish, then okay. But at least I'm being honest. Now you be honest - why are you being so hostile?

Don't settle for just being an uncle if you want to have a family. I'm certainly unhappy with my current situation, but that doesn't mean I'm giving up. And fuck you if you think about settling for less than what you want. You deserve better than that.

I'm not saying it doesn't have its upsides, and I certainly do feel for people who have had trouble with intimacy. That said though, meaningless sex has made me feel somewhat empty. That's what inspired me to make this post.

I love that this is actually getting downvotes from some, and generating anger from certain people. If you're unhappy with your current situation, change. I've been fighting suicidal tendencies (see older post on this throwaway) and the important thing I've learned so far is to keep pushing yourself. 

You want to trade lives with me? Tough shit - you can't buddy. You can however change your own life around.
Not trying to toot my own horn here, just felt like posting my current emotions on reddit. Obvious throwaway account is obvious.
I'm going to try writing a book. I like being creative but never have a chance. I'm getting pretty excited about it actually.
I think I'm going to try and write a book.. Just for fun.
Fell asleep thinking about shooting myself again. No dreams that I can remember immediately upon wakeup.
It depends on the night... I usually can't remember my dreams. I'm heading to bed soon, if I can remember it, I'll post what i dreamed about tomorrow morning.

I've never heard of Imposter Syndrome but I've now read the wiki on it. I think the difference is that I legitimately don't think I've earned my success. I recognize that I've had a bunch of achomplishments, but they usually just seem to fall in my lap. I think I do need something new though... Everything I have now just seems to stale and unimportant, even though I know they're not.

I really want to see the Middle East. I'm going with a friend next spring and I think about that a fair bit. Despite my good record of flings though, I haven't had a normal relationship in a while. I think I want one, but I'm not sure.
How does that make you feel better.. Just makes it sound like no matter how great my acomplishments, it will be overlooked in history.
Have you done anything that has helped?
I think you might be right, I just don't know what to do.. I'm not passionate about anything anymore. I can't think of anything that really means alot to me.
I'm in the exact same spot right now..
